text.en: Pet owners praise Dr. Bill McGehee, Dr. Evan, and the clinic team for their warm approach and detailed medical explanations. Reviewers highlight that doctors take ample time to answer questions and explain home care routines without rushing consultations. Clients frequently emphasize deep trust in the veterinary staff built over many years.

Clients report successful treatment outcomes across routine preventative visits, acute respiratory illnesses, and general health management. Long-term pet parents note consistent clinical quality that has kept companion animals healthy across decades of care. Reviewers express confidence in the thorough diagnostic evaluations and tailored remedies.

Reviewers appreciate the clinic's ability to care for a wide variety of animals beyond standard dogs and cats, including rabbits and pet parrots. Pet owners commend Dr. McGehee for his specialized nutritional advice and gentle handling of sensitive small pets. Clients feel reassured bringing exotic companion animals to the hospital.

q.en: Does Castle West Animal Hospital treat rabbits and exotic pets?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight knowledgeable care and dietary guidance for rabbits and parrots alongside dogs and cats.

q.en: Do veterinarians explain home treatment procedures?

a.en: Yes, pet owners appreciate that doctors demonstrate medication administration and take time to answer care questions.

q.en: Does the clinic offer digital X-rays and diagnostics?

a.en: Yes, the practice provides in-house digital radiography, diagnostic testing, and dental examinations.

q.en: Is Castle West Animal Hospital open on weekends?

a.en: No, operating hours are Monday through Thursday from 08:00 to 17:00, and Friday until 12:00.
